name: Medical Processing & Referral Orchestration Block
purpose: Automates medical grid test determination, parses clinical documents to validate vitals and BMI, and pre-formats early provisional reinsurance notifications.
failure_behaviour: Generates a manual review task with error details inside Guidewire PolicyCenter and pauses automated test dispatching.

name: Rating Compliance & Referral Dispatch Block
purpose: Audits rating overrides for compliance and compiles complete risk packages for facultative reinsurance referral.
failure_behaviour: Blocks the API call submission, flags the missing metadata field on screen, and requests the assigned underwriter input a valid justification.
